svg.aria-label: Map of Italy with 2025 VIIRS detections coloured by type: vegetation fires across the south and the islands, industrial sources in the Po valley and Taranto
svg.text: Italy, 2025: 23,349 VIIRS detections. Not all of them are fires.
Each square is 0.1°, coloured by what most of its detections are (the FIRMS type column).
of the detections are not vegetation fires:
a confidence filter keeps 98% of them.
Source: NASA FIRMS, VIIRS S-NPP archive, Italy 2025
